|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Young Skywalker]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Young Skywalker (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

Deploys -3 to Endor. Power +2 while armed with Luke's Lightsaber. Once per game, may retrieve A Jedi's Focus or A Jedi's Fury into hand. Immune to attrition &lt; 5 (&lt; 6 while armed with Luke's Lightsaber).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Young Skywalker (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 22]] (2 October 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 4, file created 6 October 2023: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -3 to Endor. Power +2 while armed with Luke's Lightsaber. Once per game, may retrieve A Jedi's Focus or A Jedi's Fury into hand. Immune to attrition &lt; 5 (&lt; 6 while armed with Luke's Lightsaber).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Young Skywalker]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Young Skywalker]] (published 2 October 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Young Skywalker”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
